title: The Boy Who Became King
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart for a brave start, and tonight eight-year-old Josiah chooses the right when the kings before him did not: Beau walks back to the end of the slide line when bigger boys call him to cut.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because choosing the right when you are small takes a big, brave heart. In Beau’s world today: at the park, two bigger boys push to the front of the slide line. “Come on, Beau, cut with us!” they call. Beau stops, then walks back to the end of the line and waits his turn. His little sister walks back with him. Just like young King Josiah, Beau learned that you are never too little to choose the right.
